verdict.label: not_comparable
verdict.rationale: The two claims address different questions. A (PMID 37734450) reports a race/ethnicity-stratified meta-analysis of SGLT2-I versus placebo CVOTs, finding reduced risk of cardiorenal outcomes (other than MACE) in White and Asian populations, with an explicit exception for HF hospitalizations in Asians. B (PMID 33140391) reports an overall pooled SGLT-2 inhibitor versus control effect on HF hospitalization without racial/ethnic stratification. The A claim explicitly excludes HF hospitalizations in Asians, so the outcome sets do not align, and A's stratified subgroup findings cannot be directly compared with B's unstratified pooled estimate. No supported contextual difference explains a directional contradiction, and the claims are not sufficiently similar in outcome scope or contrast structure for a concordant or contradictory comparison.

source_evidence.quote: SGLT2-Is reduced the risk of all other cardiorenal outcomes in White and Asian populations, except for HF hospitalizations in Asians.

The risk of hospitalization for HF was significantly lower in both groups but the magnitude of the effect was more pronounced in the SGLT-2 inhibitors group (HR 0.68, 95% CI 0.60-0.76, p < 0.001) than the GLP-1 agonists group (HR 0.92, 95% CI 0.84-0.99, p = 0.03).

diagnostics.notes: A's claim covers 'all other cardiorenal outcomes' excluding MACE but explicitly excepts HF hospitalizations in Asians; B's claim is specifically about HF hospitalization without stratification. The outcome scopes and stratification structures differ, preventing direct comparison.
